metadata.title: The Civilizational Synthesis: Global Mastery
metadata.notes: The final integration layer for a global sovereign civilization.

nodes.title: Global Mesh Governance
nodes.description: Fractal Quorums and Inter-Pod Diplomacy. Scaling the Ubuntu layer to manage global resource commoning without central authorities. Modeling high-trust network topology at scale.

nodes.title: The Blue Commons
nodes.description: Maritime reciprocity and oceanic stewardship. Legal rights of the high seas, sustainable aquaculture swarms, and managing the 70% of the living substrate.

nodes.title: Molecular Mycology & Bio-Fabrication
nodes.description: Growing the infrastructure. Using mycelial networks to synthesize bioplastics, carbon-negative building materials, and self-healing bio-sensors. (Ref. mk0.5-forge).

nodes.title: Quantum Logic & Probabilistic Thought
nodes.description: The successor to HDC. Complex-valued hypervectors, qubit-binding, and the transition from binary certainty to probabilistic amplitude in cognitive substrates.

nodes.title: Archeology of the Future
nodes.description: Deconstructing the 1602 extractive architecture. A forensic analysis of centralized failures (debt-traps, data-mining, eco-cide) to ensure the Mycelix substrate remains resilient.

nodes.title: The Civilizational Synthesis Capstone
nodes.description: The ultimate integration. Propose a modification to the global Mycelix protocol that enhances either Ahimsa, Reciprocity, or Thermodynamic Efficiency across all 16 clusters.

holonic_capstone.deliverable: A protocol-level PR or constitutional amendment verified by the Symthaea Auditor and a consensus of 100+ Pod Stewards.

edges.rationale: Global mastery requires understanding the mathematics of decentralized governance.
The future of the protocol is grounded in quantum-ready probabilistic logic.
One cannot synthesize the future without deconstructing the failures of the past.
